## Pull Request And Issue Closure

- The implementation PR must target `dev` and include `Closes #<this issue>` in its body.
- Because `main` is the repository default branch, the merge operator must verify this issue immediately after the PR merges into `dev`.
- If GitHub leaves the issue open and the acceptance criteria are satisfied, close it manually as `completed`.
- If the work is superseded or intentionally abandoned, close it as `not planned` instead of `completed`.
- Delete the merged feature branch and verify that no stale remote branch remains.
